scope: Corollary 7.6 of the manuscript “Modularity of elliptic curves over imaginary quadratic fields” (preprints/Modularity-of-elliptic-curves-over-imaginary-quadratic-fields-October-4-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 030 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 c74cc37755f500be), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 20. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Choose t satisfying the open conditions of Proposition 7.5. Let v | 3p be a place of F, of residue characteristic ℓ. Then, simultaneously for every rotation character θ, the following conclusions hold. 1. If E has potentially good ordinary reduction at v, then Vθ,ℓ|GFv is potentially crystalline and potentially ordinary of weight 0. 2. If E has potentially good supersingular reduction at v, then Vθ,ℓ|GFv is potentially crystalline and is not potentially ordinary of weight 0. 3. If E has potentially multiplicative reduction at v, then the monodromy of Vθ,d|GFv has rank one for every coefficient prime d, including d = ℓ. In particular, Vθ,ℓ|GFv is not potentially crystalline.
